sentences.en: For instance, gauges, such as thermometers and barometers, are instruments.
sentences.zh: 例如，温度计和气压计之类的仪表就是例子。

sentences.en: And in several instances they relate the same event differently.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，他们对同一事件有不同的描述。

sentences.en: Japan is full of beautiful cities. Kyoto and Nara, for instance.
sentences.zh: 日本有很多美丽的城市。比如京都和奈良。

senses.zh: 例子，实例，事例，阶段，情况，诉讼程序
